name: jev-review
description: An iterative, local-first software-quality score loop for AI coding agents, powered by Jev.

interface.longDescription: Score code changes and get one-off file judgment signals with Jev. The agent diagnoses issues and makes the fixes.
defaultPrompt: Implement this change, validate it, then use jev_review to score the focused diff. Inspect weak metrics, fix concrete issues, and rescore justified changes with previousEvaluation.
Use jev_signal to answer one specific yes/no question about this file. Supply the file, clear meanings for yes and no, and context needed for a defensible judgment.
